title: GEM production-table research candidates (not validated annual production)
compilation: Global Energy Monitor Wiki, field-level Production tables; exact asset article/unit match required.
attribution: Global Energy Monitor (GEM Wiki), individual field pages linked per record; production-row citations link to the references listed per record.
method: Preserve the prior exact-name matched GEM table transcriptions and citations. The table label million bbl/y does not establish a measured annual total. No daily rate is calculated or applied from these candidates. Accepted records require independently checked product, observation period, units and asset/ownership scope in production_recheck.json.
limitations: Secondary table labels and years may conflict with original documents. Original citations, revision IDs and nominal table quantities are archived for inspection; neither latest year nor production label establishes actual production. Search/retrieval failures do not establish nondisclosure.
withdrawal_reason: Original citations show daily/quarterly rates, future targets, ownership-specific quantities and wrong transcription units. The previous conversion of 96 main asset values is withdrawn; these table rows are search leads, not accepted annual observations.
